quiz.q:
What does `Html("

Hi

")` change about the response?
options: It sets content-type to text/html so the browser renders it
quiz.explain: The Html wrapper tells Axum to send `content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8`, so a browser renders the tags instead of showing them.

quiz.q: Which command adds Axum to a new project?
quiz.explain: `cargo add` writes the dependency line into Cargo.toml for you.

quiz.q: Your server returns 404 for `/contact`. Most likely cause?
quiz.explain: Axum answers 404 for any path the Router has no rule for.

quiz.q: Why does the book's crate write `axum.workspace = true`?
options: The version is set once in code/Cargo.toml and shared by every lesson crate
quiz.explain: A Cargo workspace lets many crates share one list of dependency versions.
